verdict.reasons: The main AFP carton is the correct white-and-blue cylindrical roll, branding is authentic, and the watermark is present. However, the technical evidence match is weak for a high-pass score: the installed laterals in the scene appear to be round supply/drip lines rather than clearly flattened continuous drip-tape laterals with visible emitters/root-zone wetting. This makes the commercial package feel staged and not plausibly the actual operating plumbing, while also not fulfilling the specific drip-tape agronomy evidence cleanly. No core defects in identity, collage, people, or wrong product family.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP carton rests on open soil with a broad, uninterrupted soil gap visible across its entire footprint, including around and behind its base. All visible irrigation lateral lines in the rows are separated from the package and do not touch, emerge from, or cross its base. There is exactly one required AFP package and no distinct additional loose or uninstalled coil/roll. The sides and base of the carton are smooth with no protruding ribbon, strap, or tape tail emerging from the package.
